patterns.note: A persistent, fixed top bar (logo, hamburger menu) and bottom bar (main navigation, social links) frame the scrolling content, creating a portal-like viewing experience.
Dramatic, oversized serif typography is used for all major section headings, creating strong visual anchors against a dark background.
A high-contrast dark mode palette dominates, featuring black and deep charcoal backgrounds with crisp white text, accented by subtle gold for social icons and occasional vibrant imagery.

The hero image features a subtle parallax effect, moving independently behind the main title text as the user scrolls. Sections and individual image elements reveal with a staggered fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport.
Image galleries within sections utilize organic, irregularly shaped masks (circles, blobs) for individual photos, breaking from traditional rectangular grids.

technique_notes: Implement a fixed header and footer that remain visible and interactive throughout the scroll, effectively framing the main content area.

Achieve smooth scrolling and complex scroll-triggered animations (like parallax for hero images and staggered reveals for content sections) using a combination of a smooth scrolling library like Locomotive Scroll and a powerful animation library such as GSAP ScrollTrigger.
Create irregularly shaped image masks using SVG paths or CSS clip-path properties to give a unique, artistic presentation to photographic elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~4-6x body text) create dramatic visual impact, contrasted with smaller, clean sans-serif for body and navigation, often in uppercase.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for overall layout elements and buttons; organic, irregular shapes are used extensively for image masks.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero and between major sections, emphasizing individual elements; balanced density within text blocks and navigation.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its dramatic, large-scale serif typography that acts as a primary visual element, combined with the artistic use of organic, irregularly shaped image masks. The persistent top and bottom navigation bars create a unique framed viewing experience, enhancing the sense of a curated, high-end portfolio.
